A '''strike team''' of [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] personnel was active during the [[Galactic War]]. It was sanctioned by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to operate autonomously to avert a second war and was placed under the command of [[Ardun Kothe]].
